message: publishing is halted: strike — TEST: simulated copyright strike

history.detail: MANUAL LAUNCH IN PROGRESS. The owner is publishing the first four videos by hand (2026-08-31). The loop must not publish while she does: YouTube cannot replace a video file, so an autonomous publish landing mid-session creates a video that can only be deleted and re-uploaded, losing its URL and any watch time. Reset only when she says the manual session is finished. Deliberate hold, not a fault.

history.note: Manual launch is not happening. The 2026-08-31 API test upload landed PUBLIC and read back public - the unaudited-project private lock does not fire on this project, so there is no manual Studio session for an autonomous publish to collide with. Video 1 (qBeLl0z4s54) is live and recorded in the ledger. Handing publishing to the loop.

unblock: Fix the underlying cause, then: python loop/breaker.py reset --note "<what you fixed>"
disposition_why: 'BREAKER_TRIPPED' is not in loop/stop_policy.json, so it is treated as needing a human. That is the default on purpose.
